value.rationale: An explicit 2026 open question asks for graph-theoretic Rota–Baxter classifications on perfect evolution algebras. The theorem determines the exact nonzero-operator threshold and *all* possible active natural-basis supports over arbitrary fields for every weighted permutation graph. It produces a natural complete invariant with \(2^r\) patterns, a uniform r-dimensional diagonal moduli, and non-diagonal rank-one operators alongside invertible ones. These are structurally meaningful field-dependent phenomena rather than isolated small examples.
